subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should this issue be the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella for abort-to-release, liveness, crash resume, and completion-drive work?
rationale: The source evidence confirms the problem class, but the proposed solution chooses cross-cutting lifecycle ownership and persistence behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split them into small implementation tracks with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A First
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale-running takeover as the only near-term approved work while deferring durability and completion-drive policy.

options.title: Keep Reports Separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and keep landing narrower fixes against the linked production reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split them into small implementation tracks with source and live proof.
